sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Rajan Roy,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
Heard.

Shri Vinod Kumar Singh, learned Additional C.S.C. has instructions from the Police of Police Station - Khorade, Tehsil - Mankapur, District - Gonda, that the Police is not interfering in the running of the meat shop of the petitioner.

sentences.text: 1 In view of the aforesaid, nothing survives for adjudication in the matter, as, the grievance of the petitioner was against the Police personnel, who, as informed by the Standing Counsel, are not interfering.
The petitioner is free to run the meat shop, subject to the license being valid and still operative, and also, subject to any orders passed by the competent authorities under the relevant statutes.
The writ petition is accordingly disposed of.

Lokesh Kumar [Om Prakash Shukla, J.] [Rajan Roy, J.]
